quotes.title: K2-229
quotes.card: K2-229 is a K-type main sequence star approximately 103 parsecs away in the constellation Virgo.
quotes.introduction: It was observed by the Kepler Space Telescope during its K2 "Second Light" mission in Campaign 10.
